title: Eurostat Indicators Explorer
text: Website Shiny app, built golem package, exploring indicators Eurostat, statistical office European Union: 27 countries EU, 4 EFTA 9 candidate countries, EU-27 average comparison, regions Europe. follows layout golemworldbank.

title: Eurostat Indicators Explorer
text: Country Comparison: indicator years countries pick, EU-27 average dashed line Barplot: countries ranked indicator, race years, country pick red Map: countries colored indicator, animated year Regions: regions Europe (NUTS 2) colored indicator, GDP per inhabitant unemployment, animated year Scatterplot: countries two indicators, animated year, correlation two year Indicators: every indicator app, unit, definition link dataset Eurostat

title: Eurostat Indicators Explorer
text: Open RStudio (R console) run: Without devtools, install source tarball latest release, rebuilt main every change, together PDF manual:
code: # Install devtools if you haven't already install.packages("devtools") # Install golemeurostat from GitHub devtools::install_github("sedzinfo/golemeurostat") install.packages(   "https://github.com/sedzinfo/golemeurostat/releases/download/latest/golemeurostat_0.0.0.9000.tar.gz",   repos = NULL, type = "source" )

title: Eurostat Indicators Explorer
text: package folder: data charts can also used R: Eurostat codes countries two letters, ISO , except Greece, EL.
